notes: Systemic: (1) 24 of 32 records are link-only stubs, so summaries/tags/UN equivalents were AI-generated from titles alone, and several titles are wrong. At least 5 record titles are bound to the wrong CONTRAN number (37/1998 is anti-theft alarms; 215/2006 is quebra-mato bull bars; 498/2014 is interior-material flammability; 764/2018 is horn sound test not multimedia; 827 is a 2021 COVID Alagoas resolution, not a 1998 horn rule; 924/2022 is school-transport mirrors only). Title/number pairs for the stub CONTRAN records should be verified against the gov.br resolution list. (2) atic-ts.com, used as source_url and described as the 'official certification body', is a private consultancy page, not an official source. (3) un_equivalent_ai tags on stubs are often generic guesses (R155/R10 for non-cyber topics). (4) Seat-belt reminder 936/2022, 913, 960, 964, 966, 915, 912, 224 were checked against search snippets and found consistent in subject; 951 and 949 consistent with body text. Items not verifiable beyond snippets: 224 and 758 current status (possible later consolidation).
